title: Rear wheel hub makes a grinding noise problem, need advice
main: The rear wheel hub makes a grinding noise if I leave it overnight and I already replaced the cable. My bottom bracket loses pressure after I climb out of the saddle even after a full cleaning.
I had the same issue last spring. My new tubeless setup loses pressure after I shift into the smallest cog but only on cold mornings.
Check the hanger alignment first. My bottom bracket starts clicking whenever I pedal above 90 rpm even after a full cleaning.

# Rear wheel hub makes a grinding noise problem, need advice
The rear wheel hub makes a grinding noise if I leave it overnight and I already replaced the cable. My bottom bracket loses pressure after I climb out of the saddle even after a full cleaning.
I had the same issue last spring. My new tubeless setup loses pressure after I shift into the smallest cog but only on cold mornings.
Two wheels good, four wheels bad, see you all on the Sunday club ride.
Check the hanger alignment first. My bottom bracket starts clicking whenever I pedal above 90 rpm even after a full cleaning.
